hits.draft:
Late vote "jumps" have two possible explanations, and you can check which one it is.

1. A county dumped a batch of mail or early ballots. That's normal, and the county log will show it.
2. Something's wrong. Then the batch won't match the canvass, the poll books, or the audit.

Pull the county's batch report before you post the chart. Receipts beat screenshots.
hits.video_tip: 15s: screen-record a county results page and scroll to the 'batch/upload time' table. Circle one jump and match it to a timestamp. On-screen text: 'Find the batch.'

hits.text: 🚨#BREAKING: Hacked Russian government records reveal nearly 400,000 Russians have been killed fighting in Ukraine since the war began.
hits.draft:
"Hacked records reveal..." is the start of a story, not the end.

Before you share a leak, ask:
• Who got the files, and can anyone else see them?
• Do the totals match other independent counts?
• Has a second outlet verified them?

Leaks can be real. They can also be planted. Verify first, then post.

patterns: Stephen Miller as White House Chief of Staff was the weekend's biggest storyline: 50 hits (~2.73M views). Gunther's 'Trump making Miller CoS BROKE the Left' got ~156k views at a 10.5% like rate, and alx's 'Miller Time' one-liners each cleared 20k

Sunday-show clips won raw reach: 35 hits (~3.35M) on Dana Bash / AG Todd Blanche / Robert Garcia 'lawyer up' / Doocy–Khanna. Blanche's 'do I see it as my job?' got ~1.43M views but only a 0.3% like rate

Thune blame drew the best like rates: 27 hits (~1.25M). 'Monday would be the perfect day to fire John Thune and deport Ilhan Omar' got ~180k at 15.2%, and the 'remove Thune from leadership' asks ran at 15–16%
Hegseth impeachment and the Iran war defense: 26 hits (~2.18M). 'That war started in 1979' got ~472k at 7.0%, and the Rubio 'LOYAL' clip ~417k
Distrust of election counts plus the SAVE Act: 17 hits (~1.6M). 'Alaska Senate race is over' got ~546k, and 'Does ANYONE believe these numbers?' ~451k
Culture flashpoints: UK Russell Brand vs migrant rape gangs (4 hits, ~1.13M, led by ~921k at 4.2%) and the Chappelle/Charlie Kirk joke and 'I've Had It' sponsor backlash (18 hits, ~1.15M)
Elon/X lane: 25 hits (~2.15M). Musk 'just say the word' on contracts got ~726k; Gunther's '@grok, is Elon Satoshi?' ~332k; alx pushed 𝕏 Money 'Financial DDoS' posts (~23–26k each)
virals_narrative: The outsider AI sweep (last ~48h, ~20 unique posts) was dominated by the Nvidia/Jensen Huang story: reports citing U.S. intelligence that Huang had a relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. Leaders were @tatthang's 'chip embargo... Alice Huang' thread (~1.59M), @arshdeep3444 (~122k), @junogsp7 'NVIDIA scandal developing' (~98k) and @TheFigen_ (~55k); these are allegations from anonymous sources, and some replies note they are unproven. Smaller lanes were AI-bubble/AI-stock selloff worry (@hmalviya9 ~6k; '$13.2T wiped' and Nasdaq −3.4% weekly posts under 1k) and backlash against AI slop / AI-generated content. X News had Anthropic's Amodei on entry-level job cuts and lawmakers pushing to ban recursive self-improvement. None of the outsider posts reached the watchlist's reach; Gunther's '@grok, is Elon Satoshi?' (~332k) was the closest AI-adjacent watchlist hit.
narrative_synthesis: Weekend window (Fri→Mon): Trump naming Stephen Miller Chief of Staff and the Sunday-show clips (Bash/Blanche, Garcia's 'lawyer up') carried the reach. Thune-removal calls still earned the best like rates going into Monday. Iran/Hegseth impeachment defense, distrust of election counts (Alaska, 'look at the jumps'), and culture flashpoints (UK's Russell Brand, Chappelle/Charlie Kirk) filled out the board. rawsalerts posted only 5 originals but all were hits (Haiti/Bukele ~618k, 'I've Had It' sponsors ~476k, Russian casualty leak ~444k). alx marked 10 years since Trump's 2016 win (~511k).
